description: List posts created through the Schedulala API. Filter by status (draft, scheduled, posted, failed, cancelled), platform, or brandId, and paginate with page/limit. Date-range filtering uses 'after'/'before' (ISO 8601) on scheduled time.

after.description: Only posts scheduled at/after this ISO 8601 datetime.

before.description: Only posts scheduled at/before this ISO 8601 datetime.

name: list_posts
title: List Posts
